mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `order` (order_no, user_id, window_id, amount, status, pickup_code, pickup_time, remark) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{windowId}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{pickupCode}, #{pickupTime}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT o.*, u.real_name AS userName, w.name AS windowName FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN canteen_window w ON w.id = o.window_id WHERE o.id = #{id}

SELECT o.*, u.real_name AS userName, w.name AS windowName FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN canteen_window w ON w.id = o.window_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.id DESC

mapper.update: UPDATE `order` SET status = 'PAID', pay_time = NOW(), pickup_code = #{pickupCode} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_item (order_id, dish_id, dish_name, price, quantity) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{dishId}, #{dishName}, #{price}, #{quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM `order` WHERE status IN ('PAID', 'PICKED')
SELECT dish_name AS name, SUM(quantity) AS total FROM order_item GROUP BY dish_id, dish_name ORDER BY total DESC
